profile.headline: System Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Highly motivated and dedicated mechanical engineer eager to demonstrate and build upon my skillset to promote my employers' success.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop new features for existing software components on a Linux Operating System (RHEL 6 and
RHEL 8)
• Maintain and implement software design changes to both front end and back end of software application
• Use git for source code versioning and documentation to report progress to team and customers
• Helped with effort to transition to use git as a new source code versioning tool from Clearquest and
Clearcase
• Work in an Agile software development environment
• Completed scrum master duties while performing day-to-day software development
• Aid software integration testers in debugging software and hardware issues found during lab testing

positions.title: TRACK Engineer
positions.description:
TRACK is a rotation program at General Motors that allows recent college graduates to experience several departments within the company before solidifying a permanent position.  The TRACK program provided the opportunity to experience the infotainment and mechanical sectors of the company, as well as explore several periods within the the vehicle development process.  Below is a list of the positions experienced along with the respective responsibilities: 

Integration Design Engineer 
July 2019-Jan 2020
-Aid studio in creating a design that follows Cadillac theme, while also assisting engineering in meeting criteria and performance goals 
-Expert in sensor farm modules aiding current Cadillac programs to create the most concise packages for the sensor farm  

Complete Seat Design Release Engineer 
Jan 2020-July 2020
-Supported program management through critical GVDP gates internally at GM and externally with supplier. Critical gate support includes:
      -Appearance reviews
      -Peer Reviews
      -Validation 
      -PMT, VPIT, CORE meetings
-Collaborated with GM and supplier engineers to solve problems when seat design did not GM standards

Systems Integration Engineer
Jul 2020-Dec 2020
-Tested software releases through manual and automated tests during the the 65-80% gates in the GVDP
-Experience in several software systems, allowing me to employ my knowledge across systems i.e. understand and root cause unwanted behaviors between systems
-Expert in connectivity, building a thorough knowledge on system behaviors relating to bluetooth, Android Auto, Carplay, and USB connections
-Expert in automation setup
